name: Onimaru
source:
A guy from another school whom Memory and her friend meet at Asakusa Station. He runs the occult zine "Onimaru's Spooky Stories" by himself as a hobby, posting issues online and advertising them by discretely putting up posters in out-of-the-way places around the city.

He seems somewhat suspicious at first glance but turns out he's quite friendly, kind, and chill. Due to his constant efforts, the zine is gaining fans at a steady rate, and dreams of turning it into a nationwide phenomenon. He loves ghost stories, science fiction, horror, and other dark topics, often scouring the internet for new tales and concepts.
[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943040]Steam[/url]]
